title: The Snooze Commute
logline: Max lives four minutes from work and is always late. Priya lives an hour away and is always early. The math is brutal.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: You live four minutes from the office, Max.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Exactly. So I can leave at nine.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: I live one hour away, and I am always early.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: That is not fair. You have a bus.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Fine. Show me the math, then.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Short trip, nine snoozes. Long trip, one snooze.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: So the city is not the problem at all?

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: The problem has nine buttons. You press all of them.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Nine minutes late. New personal best!

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Step two. Set one alarm. Not nine.
